question: 上个月各品类的毛利率

steps.title: 理解问题，映射到语义层

metrics.label: 毛利率
metrics.description: 毛利额 ÷ 已支付且未退款订单的商品实付。

steps.title: q1 返回 6 行，用时 2.3 ms

result.question: 上个月各品类的毛利率

metrics.label: 毛利率
metrics.description: 毛利额 ÷ 已支付且未退款订单的商品实付。

answer.text: 上个月（2026年9月），毛利率最高的品类是美妆个护（53.9%），最低的是数码家电（22.2%）。

queries.title: 毛利率
queries.sql:
SELECT
  p.category AS category,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.pay_amount - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) AS gross_profit,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.pay_amount), 2) AS paid_sales,
  ROUND(
    SUM(oi.pay_amount - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.pay_amount), 0),
    4
  ) AS gross_margin
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  p.category
ORDER BY
  gross_margin DESC,
  category
LIMIT 1000
queries.executed_sql:
SELECT
  p.category AS category,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.pay_amount - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) AS gross_profit,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.pay_amount), 2) AS paid_sales,
  ROUND(
    SUM(oi.pay_amount - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.pay_amount), 0),
    4
  ) AS gross_margin
FROM (
  SELECT
    item_id,
    line_amount,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price
  FROM order_items
) AS oi
JOIN (
  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
) AS o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN (
  SELECT
    brand,
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    unit_cost,
    unit_price
  FROM products
) AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  p.category
ORDER BY
  gross_margin DESC,
  category
LIMIT 1000

metrics.label: 净销售额

answer.text: 2025年第3季度，净销售额最高的渠道是线下门店（54.47 万元），最低的是App（25.85 万元）。

queries.title: 净销售额
queries.sql:
SELECT
  o.channel AS channel,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount - o.refund_amount), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM orders AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'
GROUP BY
  o.channel
ORDER BY
  net_revenue DESC,
  channel
LIMIT 1000
